title: Embedding a machine configuration
statement: Given a configuration $c$ of a machine with $m$ work tapes on a Boolean input, define a configuration of the compiled machine on the same input by mapping any present state to the corresponding ordinary program state and retaining the input-head position and output. The first $m$ work-tape contents and head positions are retained, while each of the additional $k_D$ tapes is blank everywhere and has its head at position $0$.
hypotheses_covered: Types of program locations and decider states
A configuration on that input with $m$ work tapes
